title: Protein Banana Bread

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups white, spelt, or oat flour
1/2 cup pure maple syrup, honey, or agave
Optional: chocolate chips, walnuts, coconut, etc.
directions: Grease a 9x5 loaf pan and line the bottom with parchment paper. Preheat the oven to 350°F.

Stir all ingredients together, smooth the batter into the pan, and bake for 40 minutes. Turn the oven off but do not open the door even a crack. Leave the protein banana bread in the closed oven for an additional 5 minutes.

Let cool, then go around the sides with a knife and invert onto a plate. If yours is still soft in the center, cover the top with tin foil and continue baking until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out mostly clean.

notes: 10g protein per slice. Serves 10–12 slices. The taste and texture are even better the next day!
